name: held-by-column
title: The promises and the tests that hold them, written down
description: The last two rounds established by hand that each of the ten refusal table promises has an implementation and a holder. A count with no reader is worth little, so write the mapping into the table as a Held by column and add a check that every named test resolves - declaring that the check holds the pointers, not the judgement
